entries.episode: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty
entries.scene: Recreate ONLY THE EMPTY ARCHITECTURE of Arsenal Gear's STOMACH equipment chamber in MGS2. All people and bodies in the reference sheets are omitted. Match the actual small room with teal-grey paneled steel walls, angled waist-height console banks with dark CRT screens and green indicator buttons, vertical grey vented server cabinets, a large industrial upright metal fixture on a broad dark rectangular base against the rear wall, thick dark electrical cables running from its base along the floor, and large pale round overhead pipe housing. Preserve the compact angular 2001 PlayStation 2 architecture, cyan-green lighting, square grey metal floor and plain slab doors. The fixture is EMPTY, with the original mechanical supports only. No visible person, injury or scene of violence. No added prison bars, electric chair redesign, clinical modern equipment, or futuristic neon holograms.
